ND.openHint: Browse the district map and journals you may observe.
ND.choosePlace: Open a numbered marker or choose a district. GMs can add the selected map's starter dossiers through GM Tools.
ND.mapAlt: City map with interactive dossier markers
ND.mapHint: Relative local image path, e.g. worlds/my-world/maps/district.webp. No remote URLs.
ND.examplesReady: Starter places are ready. Share each dossier when appropriate.
ND.error: Neon Dossiers could not complete the action:
ND.gmOnly: Only a GM can change dossiers.
ND.invalidPlace: An invalid dossier was skipped. See the console for details.
ND.imageError: A local dossier or map image could not be loaded. Check its path and file access.
ND.shared: Default access: all players can observe.
ND.private: Default access: private. Individual grants may exist; check Permissions.
ND.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this place and its private GM notes?
ND.title: Title
ND.positionHelp: Click the map while editing, or enter coordinates from 0 to 1.
ND.mapHelp: Drag the map to pan. Use + / - to zoom. Route / Places opens navigation and the location index.
ND.mapControls: City map: drag or use scrollbars and arrow keys to pan
ND.noStarterData: No starter places are provided for this custom map. Add your own dossiers.
ND.campaignDefaults: Threat levels and scale are campaign defaults, not official ratings. Boundaries, POI anchors and the partial street network are approximate.
ND.invalidAtlas: Invalid map configuration. Check the local map path in module settings or restore a valid atlas configuration.
ND.pickStartHelp: Click the map background to set your starting position.
ND.routeEstimate: Estimate along configured roads. Amber dashes: GM-traced walking access (5 km/h). Street positions snap by at most 20 m. No live traffic or encounter delays.
ND.flightEstimate: Straight-line flight estimate. Ignores buildings, airspace restrictions and landing time.
ND.noRoads: No roads configured for this mode. Ask the GM to configure the street graph.
ND.noRoute: No connecting road route. Check bridges, disconnected roads or choose a different mode.
ND.invalidAccess: The assigned road access node is missing or unavailable for this travel mode.
ND.unconnectedPlace: Start or destination is not connected to the street graph. The GM must trace an access path or add roads. No free connection across water or buildings is generated.
ND.drawRoadHelp: Click consecutive street points on the map. Click existing nodes to actually connect them. Trace streets and bridges only, not water or buildings. Crossing lines are not connected without a shared node. Choose travel modes; changes apply only on save.
ND.invalidRoad: Choose at least two distinct street points and one travel mode.
ND.oneWay: One-way in drawing direction (for the selected travel modes)
ND.networkHelp: Traced partial network, not a complete street or traffic-rule survey. Colors distinguish connected components. Amber circles: endpoints (including legitimate dead ends). Red circles: geometric crossings without a shared node; these may be overpasses and are NOT connected automatically. Click a segment to edit modes, direction or delete it. Connectivity ignores direction; a one-way street may still prevent the return route.
ND.confirmDeleteRoad: Remove this street segment? Routes or place access paths may become unusable.
ND.confirmPresetRoads: This map family's street nodes and segments will be replaced by the current module preset. Custom street edits will be lost. Districts, scale, dossiers and other map families are preserved. Existing access paths may have moved or invalid nodes afterwards; review them. First copy a JSON backup from Map / districts / roads.
ND.presetRoadsReady: Preset streets loaded. Please review existing place access paths.
ND.accessHelp: Without access, the place must be within 20 m of a mapped street. Otherwise trace a walkable path from the place, point by point, and finish by clicking a red street node. Amber access paths are walked even for bike/car trips. GM-authored geometry, not automatic obstacle detection.
ND.finishAccess: Finish the access path by clicking a street node, or cancel tracing first.
ND.sceneUnavailable: The Neon Dossiers map scene is not ready. The GM must create it and activate it for players.
ND.sceneUpdating: The map scene is being updated. If this message remains, the active GM must reopen the map scene; check error notifications.
ND.atlasHelp: Configure image dimensions, width in km, districts and road nodes/edges as JSON. Coordinates are normalized (0-1). This entire configuration is public. Preset map scales, threat levels and partial roads are campaign approximations. See README.
ND.mapMismatch: Select the map image first; the configuration image must match it.
ND.invalidDistrict: The selected district no longer exists.
ND.roadNode: Road access node ID (optional; no automatic distant access)
ND.sceneReady: Map scene updated. Dossiers, routes and GM tools are overlaid directly on the scene. Activate it in Foundry to bring players.
